payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for predicting implicit and explicit discourse relations, indicating which types the model works best and worst for.

claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting explicit discourse relations, with a macro F1-score of over 92%.
The model performs worst for implicit discourse relations, achieving a macro F1-score of 48.82%, which is significantly lower than for explicit relations.
The model shows improved performance on contingency relations among implicit discourse relations, indicating variability in performance across different types.
